chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Hārūn ibn Khārijah, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: If you commit forgetfulness in the Maghrib prayer, then repeat the salat (prayer).

Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan said: Most of the narrations that we have cited in the first chapter also include mention of the Maghrib prayer along with mention of the morning prayer, and they reinforce these reports.

key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat (prayer)
key_terms.سَهَوْتَ: you became forgetful or made an inadvertent mistake in prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone has sahw (forgetfulness) in the Maghrib prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states that if forgetfulness occurs in the Maghrib prayer, the salat (prayer) is to be repeated. The compiler then notes that earlier narrations mentioning both Maghrib and the morning prayer support and strengthen this ruling.
